hypothesis: Less source cleanup and more trustworthy source-grounded retrieval while keeping the vault portable and privately owned.
baseline_candidates: A suitable bibliographic manager with browser capture
scenario: Import a mixed corpus of papers, webpages and local notes with duplicates, amended documents, missing metadata and broken URLs. Create a claim with citations, retrieve it offline, change a source, export the vault, then reimport in a clean environment. Compare actual cleanup effort, citation correctness and retention of annotations.
failure_cases: Search returns stale evidence as current
metrics: Export/reimport data loss and vendor lock-in
